description: Hand the sound over to whoever mixes next (Resolve/Fairlight, Pro Tools, a dubbing studio): every stem of the sequence (dialog, music, sfx, atmo) as a 24-bit / 48 kHz stereo WAV, rendered the way it goes into the mix — effects, fader, pan and ducking baked in — plus an M&E file (music + effects + atmo WITHOUT the ducking on the dialog, for dubbed versions). All files start at the start of the sequence and are exactly the same length, so they line up at 00:00 in any DAW. Delivered as ONE zip with stems.json (format, length in samples, loudness/true peak per file) and LIESMICH.txt. The master (EQ/compressor/limiter) and the loudness normalisation are NOT in the stems: their sum is the mix before the master. Needs bound stems (lab_bind_audio). Runs as a BACKGROUND JOB: poll lab_get_job — stems_zip_url is in job.result. Changes nothing in the mix, costs nothing. Picture handover is lab_schnitt_export.
